verdict.rationale: OpenRouter documents a management API for creating and rotating API keys programmatically (openrouter-docs-8), confirmed by community users who like key minting with per-key limits (openrouter-comm-12), and it supports workspace-level spending budgets/caps (openrouter-docs-10, openrouter-comm-11). However, there's no explicit 'gateway' provisioning concept, and budgets are described as a feature/setting rather than clearly exposed via the same admin API as keys, so full programmatic control across all three axes (gateways, keys, budgets) isn't fully evidenced.
